pb-dev.title: Developer reviews
pb-dev.intro: Review a local source copy. Approve each tool request and each change.
pb-dev.sourceHelp: Attach a source.txt file to this order in Work. It contains repository, revision and files, with path and content for each file. Keep secrets out.
pb-dev.utcHelp: Use an exact time such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z.
pb-dev.quoteHelp: This quote must be at the selected path and first line.
pb-dev.reviewHelp: Read the whole source and complete required audits before confirming. An empty list does not prove safety.
pb-dev.exportPreview: Original report text; download is unchanged
pb-dev.actionsHelp: Coding output needs review. Chausar never tests a live target or pushes your repository.
pb-dev.costHelp: Code calculates this maximum from the recorded rate. Open its receipt before approving.
pb-dev.auditHelp: Only the approved package metadata goes to the npm registry. No install, scripts or fix runs. Additional scanners stay manual until a reviewed adapter is available.
pb-dev.pushHelp: This command is for you to run yourself. Approval records a handoff, not a verified push.
pb-dev.handedOff: Handed to you. No push verified.
pb-dev.ownerReported: Owner report saved. No independent push confirmation.
pb-dev.error.REQUEST_FAILED: Could not save this review. Check the source and try again.
pb-dev.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQUEST: Check the fields and use the stated format.
pb-dev.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The source or review changed. Read it again before approving.
pb-dev.error.DERIVED_STALE: The original source or client scope changed. Prepare a fresh review.
pb-dev.error.DEV_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: This review is no longer available. Prepare current source.
pb-dev.error.DEV_SOURCE_INVALID: Use a bounded text snapshot on this order with repository, revision and source files.
pb-dev.error.DEV_SECRET_FOUND: Remove possible secrets from the copied source or proposal.
pb-dev.error.DEV_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Quote the current source at the exact stated line.
pb-dev.error.DEV_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Read the whole source, complete checks and review blocking findings.
pb-dev.error.DEV_AUDIT_REQUIRED: Run the required audit on this source before exporting.
pb-dev.error.DEV_SCAN_REQUIRED: Include the current package.json and package-lock.json in the source copy.
pb-dev.error.DEV_SCANNER_REQUIRED: Open desktop with a supported installed scanner. No scanner is downloaded automatically.
pb-dev.error.PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Record current written permission from the code owner for this repository and window.
pb-dev.error.FIRST_WEEK_REPORT_ONLY: The first week is report only. Changes wait until it ends.
pb-dev.error.DEV_EXPLOIT_REFUSED: Use remediation advice without exploit commands or attack steps.
pb-dev.error.PRIVATE_NEEDS_LOCAL: Private source stays manual until a qualified local coding tool is available.
pb-dev.error.TIER_UNAVAILABLE: Set up your own supported coding tool on desktop. Use the manual review meanwhile.
pb-dev.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: Security delivery waits for named professional review. Prepare a manual report meanwhile.
pb-dev.error.SEND_DISABLED: Sending is off. Change your sending choice before requesting a tool.
pb-dev.error.DEV_CLI_PENDING: Check the previous coding run before starting another.
pb-dev.error.CLIENT_NOT_FOUND: The client is no longer available. Start with a current client.
